Hi Samir — thanks for the clear ask. Attaching a lean blueprint (GSlides) and a working MAP doc that we use for mid-market pilots. Both are intentionally modular so you can swap in dates and owners.

Highlights in the doc:
- Week 0: Tech kickoff, network validation, and test data sample handoff (owner: Nebula infra + Redwood SE)
- Week 1–2: Integration + smoke tests, initial perf pass (owner: Nebula Eng + Redwood Infra)
- Week 3: Feature acceptance and business validation (owner: Nebula PM + Redwood AE)
- Week 4: Acceptance, outcomes review, PO/final procurement guidance (owner: Nebula execs + Redwood AE)

Suggested procurement handoff: prepare PO draft at start of Week 3 so license and SOW reviews can complete by Week 4. If procurement needs a one-pager for internal routing, the first slide is designed for that.

I also added a short checklist for security evidence we commonly surface (SOC2 scope, audit logs, data residency notes). If procurement wants, Marissa can run a quick gap review with your security point-of-contact.

Sharing the links: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1OrchBlueprintSeed (MAP doc)
https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1SlidesSeed (Slide seed)

Attachments: 30d-eval-canvas.gslides (presentation), orchestration-blueprint-template.gdoc (doc)

Next step: if this looks good, can you propose owners and dates by EOD Thursday so we can lock the draft? Otherwise happy to schedule a 30-minute alignment call.

Cheers,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com
